input: Build a LAMMPS data file for a 2x2x1 supercell of the tobermorite 14 Å unit cell from the INTERFACE FF 1.5 model database (tob14_avg_cell) with the PCFF-INTERFACE force field (pcff_interface_v1_5.frc): atom_style full, real units, periodic in x, y and z, all force-field coefficients and masses written in the data file, triclinic tilt within LAMMPS's documented bound.
note: 14 Å supercell in the layer plane
